description.value: Hotel Zed Kelowna is a BC-owned, retro-themed boutique hotel on Abbott Street in the heart of Kelowna, part of a small chain also operating in Victoria and Tofino. The property leans into a 1970s aesthetic with quirky lobby decor, board games, and typewriters, and offers a seasonal pool, hot tub, and sauna. It is marketed as an inclusive, personality-driven alternative to conventional hotel stays in the Okanagan.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Hotel Zed Kelowna at 1627 Abbott St, phone 250-763-7771, and email kelowna@hotelzed.com, all consistent with OSM. A notable discrepancy exists: OSM spells the brand 'Zedd' (double-d) while the official website consistently uses 'Zed' (single-d).
concerns: OSM name spells the brand 'Zedd' (double-d) but the official website consistently uses 'Zed' (single-d) — the OSM tag likely contains a typo.
